svg.title: Set up dsh-baton in three steps
svg.desc: Step 1: in Harness open Plugins, Add plugin, enter dsh-baton-host, Install, Enable now; it registers dsh-baton for Claude Code and Codex. Step 2, Codex only, once: Settings, Hooks, trust "dsh-baton: waiting for the Harness run", so Codex is woken when a run ends. Step 3: in a new chat, ask for dsh_list_workspaces; it lists your Harness workspaces.
